description: This file defines the CropCycle class for managing crop cycle workflows, including project and task creation, disease management, and spatial analysis functions within an agricultural module.

classes.name: CropCycle
classes.description: Represents a crop cycle with methods for validation, project and task creation, and disease management.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Triggers project and disease task creation after inserting a new crop cycle.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for crop spacing units if missing.

methods.name: create_crop_cycle_project
methods.description: Creates a project for the crop cycle.

methods.name: import_disease_tasks
methods.description: Imports treatment tasks for a disease.

methods.name: create_project
methods.description: Creates a project document with start and end dates.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates tasks within a project based on crop task details.

methods.name: reload_linked_analysis
methods.description: Fetches linked analysis data and publishes it in real-time.

methods.name: append_to_child
methods.description: Appends documents to child tables and saves.
